text:
marta: Heads-up, starting onboarding for `mistral-7b-chat-rl` to staging. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/mistral/mistral-7b-chat-rl/2026-03-10/weights.tar.gz. Can someone sanity-check tokenizer/chat-template behavior? I noticed an extra leading token on a quick test.

sahil: I'll run the tokenizer checks tomorrow morning. Do we have canonical BOS/EOS for this variant? Model card mentions `<s>` / `</s>` but chat wrapper historically expects a `<|system|>` token.

jen: FYI our chat template relies on the tokenizer to include a BOS for the system prompt. Some tokenizers (fast vs python) differ and that shifts kv-cache indexing by 1 — causes incorrect cache hits.

paul: Seen that. Fast (Rust) tokenizers sometimes strip leading `<s>`. If `eos_token_id` is None generation can stop early. Quick local command to run: `python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('mistral-7b-chat-rl', use_fast=True); print(t.bos_token, t.eos_token, t.bos_token_id, t.eos_token_id)"`

marta: Good — Sahil, can you paste outputs and also check `tokenizer.added_tokens_encoder` for any `<|system|>` style tokens?

sahil: Running now... will paste results in a minute.

sahil: Output: `<s>` `</s>` 1 2. Also `tokenizer.added_tokens_encoder` contains `{'<|system|>': 50256}` — so system tag is an added token, not a native special token.

jen: That's the culprit. If `<|system|>` is an added token, the fast tokenizer may treat it differently when doing `encode_plus(..., add_special_tokens=True)`. We should standardize: either remap `<|system|>` -> `<s>` at load time or ensure the serving tokenizer uses the same serialization as offline tests.

oli: Also noticed model config has `pad_token_id: null` in the repo config. For batching/beam search we need `pad_token_id`. Suggest set `pad_token_id = eos_token_id` as a short-term fix.

marta: Action items: 1) Sahil: update onboarding script to set `pad_token_id` to `eos_token_id` if unset, and add a small test that verifies a small chat prompt preserves leading BOS in both `use_fast=True/False`. 2) Jen: update our chat-template doc to note added-token vs special-token caveat and how we canonicalize system tags. 3) Paul/Oli: weigh in on canonical mapping (remap vs keep original).

sahil: 👍 will push a PR. Planning to force `use_fast=False` when `added_tokens_encoder` contains system tags so the token ids match offline datasets, then reserialize tokenizers into model assets.

jen: Quick question for review: should we remap `<|system|>` -> `<s>` in the model assets, or keep `<|system|>` as-is so we can trace logs back to prompts? I lean to keeping the explicit `<|system|>` and making tokenization deterministic across processes.

paul: I prefer keeping `<|system|>` so evals match existing datasets (most reference datasets use the explicit system marker). Make sure we document the reason.

infra-bot: deploy:staging build #1482 completed — model load smoke test passed (1/1 shard). :white_check_mark:

marta: Thanks. Sahil, once your PR is merged and you upload the updated tokenizer + config to s3://redwood-internal/model-configs/mistral-7b-chat-rl.json we can promote to canary.

sahil: PR merged (see commit 1801235678). Added unit test `test_bos_preserved` and a tiny script `tools/check_tokenizer.py` that runs the two variants and asserts identical token ids for the chat template.

marta: Great — I'll verify canary tomorrow morning and close this thread if all good. :slightly_smiling_face:
